persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndrama⟨r⟩lladeva sena cuka cāsa deva pratiṣṭhā si⟨r⟩ddhāgni a itā huti yajñā yāṅā

date.as_written: saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukladaśamī mūla śaniścara vāra kuhnuḥ

notes: The catalogue reads the king's name as 'Bhūpatīndra Malla Sena', misinterpreting 'sena cuka' (courtyard name in Newari) as part of the royal name.
